title: AIMS Cameroon: call for applications
brief: The African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) Cameroon in Limbe opens applications for its Structured Master's in Mathematical Sciences, intake 2027. The programme is fully residential and taught in English by lecturers from Africa and around the world, with courses in data science, machine learning, mathematical modelling and scientific computing. Applicants need a first degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering or a related field. Applications close on Friday 30 January 2027. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Apply online through the AIMS Cameroon website.

title: AIMS Cameroon: public lecture on AI
brief: AIMS Cameroon invites students, teachers and the public to a free public lecture, "How AI learns from data: the mathematics behind ChatGPT", on Thursday 20 November 2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 at the AIMS Cameroon centre in Limbe. The lecture is given by an AIMS faculty member and is followed by questions and answers with current AIMS students. No mathematics background is needed. Seats are limited to 120 and are given on a first come, first served basis.

title: AIMS Cameroon: graduation ceremony
brief: AIMS Cameroon celebrates the graduation of its 2025-2026 Master's class on Saturday 13 June 2026 at 10:00 in Limbe. Students from several African countries will receive their Master's in Mathematical Sciences after a year of courses and research projects in areas such as epidemiology, climate modelling and machine learning. Families, partners and alumni are invited to attend. The ceremony will also be streamed live on our Facebook page.

title: Coding hackathon in Douala
brief: Douala Tech Hub organises a 24-hour youth hackathon, "Code for Our Cities", from Saturday 6 December 2026 at 9:00 to Sunday 7 December at 9:00 at our space in Akwa, Douala. Teams of 3 to 5 young people aged 16 to 25 will build apps that solve local problems such as waste collection, transport and access to clean water. Mentors from local startups will guide the teams. Food, Wi-Fi and power are provided. Participation is free but registration is required before 30 November.

title: Tree planting day in Bamenda
brief: Green Bamenda Youth Association invites volunteers to a tree planting day on Saturday 15 November 2026 from 7:30 to 12:00, starting at the Bamenda Up Station roundabout. Our goal is to plant 500 trees along the hills to fight erosion. Tools, seedlings and water are provided. Please bring a hat and wear closed shoes. Volunteers of all ages are welcome; children must come with an adult.

title: Free health screening in Yaoundé
brief: Mvog-Ada Community Health Centre in Yaoundé offers a free health screening day on Wednesday 26 November 2026 from 8:00 to 15:00. Nurses will check blood pressure, blood sugar and eyesight, and give advice on nutrition. Screening is free and open to adults of all ages; no appointment is needed. Please bring your health booklet if you have one. Results are given on the spot and are confidential.
